description: School district FUNDING AND SPENDING — revenue by source (federal / state / local) and expenditure by function, plus computed PER-PUPIL spending. Keyless federal data (NCES CCD school district finance survey, F-33). Use for "how much does <district> spend per student", "school funding by district in <state>", "which districts get the most federal money", "local vs state share of school funding". Pass a state to rank districts, or a leaid (from education_find_districts) for one district. Note the finance survey lags the directory data by 1-2 years.

leaid.description: Specific district LEA id from education_find_districts.

sort_by.description: Ranking field, largest first. Default per_pupil_spending.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter abbreviation. Required unless leaid is given.

year.description: Fiscal year. Default 2019 (the finance survey lags).

name: education_district_finance
